notes: Round 9 (scratch_r2, 2.14M decisions): the deer did a little worse. In the last quarter 38% die of old age (65% at the end of round 8), 61% starve, 1% are killed; a life in the world 445 s (609 s); feeding 15% of the time, store 0.65. The wolves now run at them (fear -0.0013 a decision, twice round 8), and court and near, open from a store of 0.4, pay 0.0013 a decision between them against 0.002 for eating: a deer at half a store is paid to walk to another one. No pair side by side, no conception. Round 10: courting, standing near and pairing only pay over a store of 0.6, and hunger costs twice as much, so the store comes first.

terms.name: graze
terms.expr: 0.004 * step(0.8 - energy) * mode_feed * step(grass_here - 0.1) * max(0, 1 - muzzle_height)

terms.name: pair
terms.expr: 0.05 * adult * (1 - pregnant) * step(energy - 0.6) * mode_mate * step(4 - mate_distance)
